args.script:
#!/bin/bash
for i in $(seq 0 6); do
    date_str=$(date -d "$i days ago" +%Y-%m-%d)
    filename="logs/log_${date_str}.txt"
    # Generate random content with random error entries
    num_errors=$((RANDOM % 20 + 5))
    num_normal=$((RANDOM % 30 + 10))
    
    > "$filename"
    for j in $(seq 1 $num_errors); do
        case $((RANDOM % 2)) in
            0) echo "2024-01-01 12:00:00 [ERROR] Something went wrong" >> "$filename" ;;
            1) echo "2024-01-01 12:00:00 [Error] A problem occurred" >> "$filename" ;;
        esac
    done
    for k in $(seq 1 $num_normal); do
        echo "2024-01-01 12:00:00 [INFO] Normal operation $k" >> "$filename"
    done
done
echo "Created log files:"
ls -la logs/
